subject: A nonfigurative composition of one central indigo axis, one gold spiral, two pale-pink biomorphic forms, and one cobalt-blue circle on a warm-white ground
prompt:

Preserve the user's requested identities, counts, setting, and layout. Add no default motifs.
VISUAL MEDIUM: flat_painting_or_print
REPRESENTATION: nonfigurative
APPLY THESE AUTHORED VISUAL RULES:
- [axis-and-cyclical-geometry] Arrange requested forms around one visible axis and use one bounded spiral, ring, or nested circle sequence to establish direction; preserve the user's requested counts and avoid a generic mandala template.
- [geometric-biomorphic-counterpoint] Set a small number of crisp geometric forms against one or two flowing biomorphic shapes, keeping their edges distinct and their relative scale intentional; do not translate them into literal plants, cells, planets, or religious emblems.
- [matte-color-fields-and-line-boundaries] Use mostly matte, even color fields from a restrained cool-warm palette; let fine, slightly imperfect line boundaries articulate selected relationships and keep value contrast sufficient for the structure to read.
- [formal-system-without-imposed-meaning] Make the requested abstract forms read as one ordered visual system through axis, cyclical movement, shape contrast, and matte color relationships; do not assign an unrequested narrative or spiritual meaning.

scope.description: A nonfigurative painting direction organized by a visible axis, a controlled spiral or circular system, and a counterpoint between geometric and biomorphic forms. Use matte color fields and fine hand-drawn boundaries to make the image read like a composed visual system rather than a literal diagram. This direction describes formal decisions only; it does not assign spiritual, scientific, or religious meaning to the user's shapes.
limitations: Use only abstract forms and symbols explicitly requested by the user; add no text, letters, religious icon, or narrative code.
Keep the requested number and relative role of geometric and biomorphic forms legible.
Do not reproduce a named af Klint painting, series composition, or exact symbol arrangement.

rules.applies_when: The user requests a nonfigurative composition with geometric or symbolic forms.
rules.instruction: Arrange requested forms around one visible axis and use one bounded spiral, ring, or nested circle sequence to establish direction; preserve the user's requested counts and avoid a generic mandala template.
rules.observable: The image has a clear structural backbone and a purposeful cyclical movement that can be described without interpreting its meaning.
rules.reject_when: Multiple competing centers appear, geometry becomes a random scatter, or added symbols change the user's requested form count.
rules.avoid: generic mandala, zodiac wheel, extra glyphs, and copied series layouts

rules.applies_when: The user requests both geometric and organic abstract form, or permits their formal contrast.
rules.instruction: Set a small number of crisp geometric forms against one or two flowing biomorphic shapes, keeping their edges distinct and their relative scale intentional; do not translate them into literal plants, cells, planets, or religious emblems.
rules.observable: Constructed and organic shapes remain separately readable and form a deliberate visual relationship without becoming a literal scene.
rules.reject_when: One shape vocabulary overwhelms the other, forms become identifiable objects not requested, or the contrast reads as random decoration.
rules.avoid: unrequested celestial bodies, botanical motifs, body organs, and sacred iconography

rules.applies_when: The requested abstraction uses color blocks and drawn boundaries.
rules.instruction: Use mostly matte, even color fields from a restrained cool-warm palette; let fine, slightly imperfect line boundaries articulate selected relationships and keep value contrast sufficient for the structure to read.
rules.observable: Color adjacency and line, rather than realistic light or texture, establish hierarchy; surfaces remain calm and planar.
rules.reject_when: Gloss, glow, cast shadows, or heavy texture make the work read as a digital interface or volumetric object.
rules.avoid: neon glow, metallic gradients, thick random impasto, and illegible low-contrast colors

joint_checks.instruction: Make the requested abstract forms read as one ordered visual system through axis, cyclical movement, shape contrast, and matte color relationships; do not assign an unrequested narrative or spiritual meaning.
joint_checks.observable: Requested form count and types remain intact; axis and spiral are legible; geometric and organic forms contrast; flat color and fine boundaries carry the hierarchy without literalized symbols.

review.note: Successful compilation is not image-quality validation or a maturity upgrade.
